shots.beat: A world is heard before it is seen
shots.description_he: תקריב נמוך של רגלי עובר הדרך המבוגר בלבד, מן הברכיים מטה: בדיוק שתי רגליים ושתי כפות רגליים בסנדלי עור פשוטים. הנוסע השני מחוץ לפריים; דרך מדברית מטפורית בשחר.
shots.prompt_subject_en: ORIGINAL mature hand-painted cinematic 2.5D panoramic 16:9 frame, low knee-to-ground camera: EXACTLY ONE adult traveler visible from both knees down, EXACTLY TWO connected human legs and EXACTLY TWO anatomically coherent feet, the older anonymous traveler only. Both lower legs connect naturally to one body continuing ABOVE the frame; clear visual separation between legs. One foot bears weight on rough ochre stone and sand, the other lifts naturally in a believable RIGHT-to-LEFT stride. Plain ancient-feeling leather sandals with simple straps and thin flexible leather soles; NO buckles, rubber, modern tread or plastic. Only a glimpse of the same weathered deep-plum/slate-blue mantle hem over a cream woven tunic as the older traveler in OPN02. NO other people, background travelers, ghost limbs, detached feet, duplicate toes, inscriptions, artist signatures, pseudotext or logos. Unnamed rocky desert path with distant ridge, blue-violet layered dawn cloud, restrained copper-amber LEFT rim light, cool readable shadows, dust and painterly tactile grain. Slightly desaturated, dramatic yet warm and human, no famous-film imitation, no known Sinai landscape. This is one still illustration, NOT walking animation.
shots.acting: show unequal, human stride weight; secondary cloak motion later via limited layers, not fake foot cycle
sound: distant natural wind without heavy percussion
shots.cut_motivation: the next frame reveals who owns those footsteps

shots.beat: Scale of the journey dwarfs the travelers
shots.description_he: מרחב רחב, שני עוברי דרך אנונימיים קטנים מימין, רכס ומסלול פתוח לפניהם משמאל.
shots.prompt_subject_en: New ORIGINAL wide cinematic illustrated master, same two anonymous older and younger travelers, same clothing and water skin, walking RIGHT to LEFT across unnamed arid trail, foreground rocks, middle-ground human figures, far ridgeline, horizon at 40 percent frame height; breathtaking open scale but warm human stakes. Distinct layout from prior ankle detail, painterly 2.5D, soft muted golden edge light from LEFT, blue gray atmospheric distance, no identifiable religious site, no Hebrew text, no modern objects or royalty insignia.

camera.intended_movement: subtle 2 percent forward change toward travelers, no fake tracking shake

shots.acting: both figures small, one slows half a stride so the other can catch up
shots.cut_motivation: from monumental space to a question between two people

shots.beat: The young traveler cannot rely forever on the older
shots.description_he: מבוגר וצעיר נעצרים; הצעיר פונה אל המבוגר עם מבט שואל ולא מרצה.
shots.prompt_subject_en: New ORIGINAL medium two-shot. Anonymous older traveler's warm weathered face, medium beard, weathered deep-plum/slate-blue mantle over cream tunic and water skin fixed at left hip. Anonymous younger adult in beige/cream woven clothing and light shawl, short dark hair, one foot just planted and looking up from SCREEN-RIGHT toward older traveler on SCREEN-LEFT. They have paused; a simple unspoken question begins. Period-plausible unnamed road, coherent LEFT dawn key, clean hands and face with restrained realistic asymmetry, cinematic painterly 2.5D, no text or ornaments. Preserve geography and identities across OPN03-OPN06.
shots.acting: younger plants foot; breath before line; older turns eyes without whipping face

Mature painterly cinematic 2.5D, modest depth of field, no text, no copy of any specific movie still.

A simple human offering, warm LEFT dawn key in blue gray background, painterly cinema 2.5D with no excessive bokeh.
